ResearcherNotesProject: Small-scale LNG/bioLNG import + regasification terminal proposed at Port of Oxelösund (east coast, Baltic). MOU signed Aug 2022 between Avenir LNG and port authority Oxelösunds Hamn AB; Avenir to acquire 100% of project company Oxgas AB, which had already secured all environmental and construction permits.
